payload.text: **An agent session keeps the PATH it started with.** On 24 Oct devbin-cc's T10 switch looked shadowed because its Bash tool still had /opt/homebrew/bin ahead of ~/.local/bin, while a fresh login shell (env -i ... zsh -lic) had ~/.local/bin first per Molt-matts a258ad0. A PATH or zshrc change reaches only sessions started after it; judge any use dev|opt|brew proof in a fresh login shell.
